sentences.text: George Walker Bush -LRB- born July 6 , 1946 -RRB- is an American politician who served as the 43rd President of the United States from 2001 to 2009 .	43rd	List of Presidents of the United States	43rd President of the United States	List of Presidents of the United States
He was also the 46th Governor of Texas from 1995 to 2000 .	46th	List of Governors of Texas	Governor of Texas	Governor of Texas
After graduating from Yale University in 1968 and Harvard Business School in 1975 , he worked in the oil industry .	Yale University	Yale University	Harvard Business School	Harvard Business School
Bush married Laura Welch in 1977 and ran unsuccessfully for the House of Representatives shortly thereafter .	Laura Welch	Laura Bush	House of Representatives	United States House of Representatives

He later co-owned the Texas Rangers baseball team before defeating Ann Richards in the 1994 Texas gubernatorial election .	Ann Richards	Ann Richards	Texas Rangers	Texas Rangers (baseball)	1994 Texas gubernatorial election	Texas gubernatorial election, 1994

Bush was elected president in 2000 after a close and controversial win over Democratic rival Al Gore , becoming the fourth president to be elected while receiving fewer popular votes than his opponent .	close and controversial win	United States presidential election, 2000	Al Gore	Al Gore

From a prominent political family , he is the eldest son of Barbara and George H. W. Bush , the 41st President of the United States , making him only the second president to assume the nation 's highest office after his father , following the lead of John Quincy Adams .	Barbara	Barbara Bush	George H. W. Bush	George H. W. Bush	family	Bush family	John Quincy Adams	John Quincy Adams

His brother , Jeb Bush , a former Governor of Florida , was a candidate for the Republican presidential nomination in the 2016 presidential election .	Republican	Republican Party (United States)	Jeb Bush	Jeb Bush	Governor of Florida	Governor of Florida	2016 presidential election	United States presidential election, 2016
His paternal grandfather , Prescott Bush , was a United States Senator from Connecticut .	Prescott Bush	Prescott Bush	United States Senator	United States Senator	Connecticut	Connecticut
The September 11 terrorist attacks occurred eight months into Bush 's first term as president .	September 11 terrorist attacks	September 11 attacks

Bush responded with what became known as the Bush Doctrine : launching a `` War on Terror '' , an international military campaign that included the war in Afghanistan in 2001 and the Iraq War in 2003 .	Bush Doctrine	Bush Doctrine	War on Terror	War on Terror	war in Afghanistan	War in Afghanistan (2001–14)	Iraq War	Iraq War

He also promoted policies on the economy , health care , education , Social Security reform , and amending the Constitution to prohibit same-sex marriage .	amending	Federal Marriage Amendment	Constitution	United States Constitution	same-sex marriage	same-sex marriage	Social Security	Social Security (United States)

He signed into law broad tax cuts , the Patriot Act , the No Child Left Behind Act , the Partial-Birth Abortion Ban Act , Medicare prescription drug benefits for seniors , and funding for the AIDS relief program known as PEPFAR .	broad tax cuts	Bush tax cuts	Patriot Act	Patriot Act	No Child Left Behind Act	No Child Left Behind Act	Partial-Birth Abortion Ban Act	Partial-Birth Abortion Ban Act	Medicare	Medicare (United States)	AIDS	AIDS	PEPFAR	President's Emergency Plan for AIDS Relief

His tenure included national debates on immigration , Social Security , electronic surveillance , and torture .	immigration	Immigration to the United States	Social Security	Social Security (United States)	electronic surveillance	NSA electronic surveillance program	torture	enhanced interrogation techniques
In the 2004 Presidential race , Bush defeated Democratic Senator John Kerry in another relatively close election .	2004	United States presidential election, 2004	John Kerry	John Kerry

After his re-election , Bush received increasingly heated criticism from across the political spectrum for his handling of the Iraq War , Hurricane Katrina , and other challenges .	Iraq War	Iraq War	criticism	Public image of George W. Bush	political spectrum	political spectrum	Hurricane Katrina	Hurricane Katrina

Amid this criticism , the Democratic Party regained control of Congress in the 2006 elections .	criticism	Public image of George W. Bush	Democratic Party	Democratic Party (United States)	2006 elections	United States elections, 2006

In December 2007 , the United States entered its longest post-World War II recession , often referred to as the `` Great Recession '' , prompting the Bush administration to obtain congressional passage of multiple economic programs intended to preserve the country 's financial system .	World War II	World War II	Great Recession	Great Recession

Nationally , Bush was both one of the most popular and unpopular presidents in history , having received the highest recorded presidential approval ratings in the wake of the September 11 attacks , as well as one of the lowest approval ratings during the 2008 financial crisis .	2008 financial crisis	Financial crisis of 2007–08
Bush left office in 2009 , returning to Texas where he purchased a home in Crawford .
He wrote a memoir , Decision Points .	Decision Points	Decision Points
His presidential library was opened in 2013 .	His presidential library	George W. Bush Presidential Center
His presidency has been ranked among the worst in historians ' polls published in the late 2000s and 2010s .
